contracts.observation_prompt: Extract only factual employment and family-relation observations from the current facts and question. Preserve exact person identifiers, relationship direction, and verbatim supporting substrings. Represent “X has father Y” as owner X, relationship father, relative Y; do not invert it, decide any statutory issue, infer an unstated gender, or treat an absent relation as negative. Each view must be one coherent reading of the same current case. Use unknown or failed extraction status when relevant text cannot be unambiguously extracted.

Extract the queried person's exact identifier and calendar year from the current question, and all remuneration/service events stated in the current case. Normalize explicit dates to canonical YYYY-MM-DD while retaining the verbatim source substring. Preserve payer, payee, the exact labor characterization, amount, inclusive service period, and whether the text expressly characterizes the whole amount as wages. Do not allocate a cross-year amount, infer wages or agricultural labor from silence, apply a monetary threshold, or decide employer status. Put genuinely ambiguous coherent readings in separate views; use unknown or failed extraction status instead of an empty resolved event list.

Extract the exact child, taxpayer, and taxable-year identifiers from the current question and every stated shared-home interval from the current case. For each interval, list exactly the people expressly said to share that home throughout the interval, normalize explicit endpoints to inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates, and retain a verbatim supporting substring. Do not determine qualifying-child status, decide whether a home is legally a principal abode, infer co-residence from kinship, or turn missing dates into a full-year interval. Put genuinely ambiguous coherent readings in separate views; use unknown or failed extraction status rather than an empty resolved record.

value.rationale: These contracts ground the unchanged kernels through role-aware relational projection and coherent event views. The family adapter directly repairs the observed argument-frame reversal: a statement that the employer has the employee as a father is inverted into the two supported child abstractions, without asserting an unobserved gender. Payment and residence adapters require source-backed, coherent alternative views; extraction uncertainty is carried through the kernels' declared status ports instead of being converted to falsehood or an empty resolved record.
